candidate.title: Non-atomic findFirst-then-create in webhook can create duplicate app credentials under concurrent requests
reports: race condition: findfirst-then-create in app-credential.ts can create duplicate credentials under concurrent webhook calls
apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:61 — concurrent first-time sync requests can both miss findfirst and create duplicate credentials.
app-credential.ts:65 performs a race-prone findfirst followed by create, allowing simultaneous first-time webhook requests to create duplicate credentials
the find-then-create/update pattern for locating a credential by userid+appid in app-credential.ts is not atomic, allowing concurrent webhook calls to race and create duplicate credential rows

credential creation performs findfirst followed by create without a transaction or uniqueness-backed atomic operation, allowing concurrent webhook deliveries to create duplicate credentials for the same user and app

findfirst-then-update/create in app-credential.ts is a check-then-act race that can create duplicate credentials under concurrent webhook deliveries; use a unique constraint on (userid, appid) plus upsert or a transaction
